description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the SearchResult interface, representing search results with functionalities to access items, pagination info, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResult
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the SearchResult interface, encapsulating search result items, pagination data, and JSON serialization functionality.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty ImmutableSearchResult instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSearchResult with specified items, next-page-offset, and cursor.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JsonObject to create an ImmutableSearchResult instance.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of result items.

methods.name: getNextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the next page offset.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cursor string.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Determines whether there is a next page based on cursor or offset.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search result is empty.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream of JsonValue items.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the items.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the search result to a JsonObject according to the provided schema version and predicate.
